transactions.asset: DreamVu Company: DreamVu (San Jose, CA) Description: Technology company that develops camera hardware and software.
transactions.comment: DreamVu is an underlying investment of SRI Capital Fund I, LP ("SRI"), a venture capital fund. Sen. Toomey and his wife have a limited partnership interest in SRI. SRI further invested in DreamVu in December. This transaction represents Sen. Toomey's share of that investment.
